source.read_scope: Full original source; parent parsed reader hash independently matches bytes

literal_predictions.minimum_effect: Fitted E_direct_measured (total group ops per target, yield-charged, vs N on log-log axes, R^2 >= 0.90 over >= 3 sizes) equals alpha/m within 0.05 at m in {3, 4, 5} and is < 1/2 at >= 1 tested (m, size) cell. The falsifier: E_direct_measured >= 1/2 at ALL tested cells.

On identical instances, (S_rel + S_LA + K*T_desc) for the unknown-log variant (scalars hidden, matrix solve) is >= the direct variant's total for K >= 1 at every tested cell; a measured ratio < 1 would mean the unknown-log variant has an unmodeled advantage and the budget correction is incomplete.

The alpha implied by E_direct_measured (alpha = m * E_direct_measured) agrees with the independently measured amortized query exponent (per IDEA-20260727-007's pre-registration: total query cost over a campaign / usable relations) within 0.1 at every cell — the self-consistency check that the exponent is being attributed to the right stage.

Measured attempts-per-success lies in [1, 2] * m! / coverage at every cell with coverage measured by exact enumeration at the smallest size — the EV-FBG-001 conservation-identity check, confirming no uncharged yield factor.

literal_falsification_conditions: TOY-TIER FALSIFIER: E_direct_measured >= 1/2 at all tested (m, size) cells with successful verification — the public-scalar budget correction is wrong as stated (the per-target cost carries an unmodeled stage or an alpha bound above m/2); the direct route closes at tested scope, and the corpus's standing gates (alpha < 3/2, m >= 5) remain the operative ones for the tested envelope. Toy-scope statement only.
TOY-TIER FALSIFIER: alpha-consistency fails (|alpha_implied - alpha_measured| > 0.1 at any cell) — the exponent is misattributed and the run is void, not negative.

CONDITIONAL-POSITIVE GATE: E_direct_measured < 1/2 at any tested cell is a conditional sub-rho budget under the measured alpha and the committed backend; per AGENTS.md rule 12 it requires independent review-breakthrough handling before any status change, and it must never be reported as a solve or as crypto-scale evidence (AGENTS.md rule 7).
Infrastructure: unknown-log variant fails to reach rank B-1 within budget, or the certificate check fails on > 0 runs — infrastructure-inconclusive, not evidence against the budget correction.
